# Satima's Blogspot

> > An author's blog dedicated to the Talismans Trilogy fantasy series, offering writing craft guides, editing expertise, and publishing insights.

Satima Flavell's personal author blog features her epic fantasy novels, particularly The Dagger of Dresnia, alongside comprehensive writing guides and editorial resources. The site combines creative portfolio pieces with practical instruction for aspiring authors, covering fiction writing, grammar, and the publishing process.

## Featured Works

- [Satima's Blogspot](https://satimaflavell.blogspot.com): Homepage for Satima Flavell's author blog featuring Talismans Trilogy
- [The Dagger of Dresnia](https://satimaflavell.blogspot.com/p/blog-page_14.html): Product page for The Dagger of Dresnia fantasy novel
- [Ruthvard's journey, the first scene I wrote for the Talismans Trilogy](https://satimaflavell.blogspot.com/p/blog-page.html): Writing sample excerpt from Talismans Trilogy featuring character Ruthvard
- [Press Release](https://satimaflavell.blogspot.com/p/press-release.html): Press release for The Dagger of Dresnia and Talismans Trilogy

## Writing Craft & Technique

- [Write it Right: notes for apprentice authors](https://satimaflavell.blogspot.com/p/blog-page_68.html): Writing advice and manuscript assessment notes for beginner authors
- [Authorial voice, passive writing and the passive voice](http://satimaflavell.blogspot.com/2010/07/authorial-voice-passive-writing-and.html): Guide on authorial voice, passive voice, and writing style in fiction
- [Writing in dialect, accent and register](https://satimaflavell.blogspot.com/p/normal-0-false-false-false-en-gb-x-none.html): Guide on writing dialogue with dialect, accent, and register variation
- [Write a decent synopsis](https://satimaflavell.blogspot.com/p/write-a.html): Tutorial on writing effective book synopses for authors
- [Does length matter?](http://satimaflavell.blogspot.com/2008/11/does-length-matter.html): Guide to story length definitions and word count guidelines for writers
- [Critiquing Groups](http://satimaflavell.blogspot.com/2006/11/critiquing-groups.html): Advice on forming and participating in writing critique groups

## Grammar & Language Reference

- [Common misuses: common expressions](http://satimaflavell.blogspot.com/2011/04/common-misuses.html): Reference guide to common expression misuses in English writing
- [Common misuses - confusing words](http://satimaflavell.blogspot.com/2011/06/common-misuses-confusing-words.html): Reference guide to commonly confused words and correct usage
- [Common misuses: pronouns – subject and object](http://satimaflavell.blogspot.com/2011/05/common-misuses-pronouns-subject-and.html): Grammar reference on pronoun case and subject-object distinctions

## Publishing & Editorial Insights

- [Satima's Blogspot: What I do](https://satimaflavell.blogspot.com/p/about.html): About page describing Satima Flavell's writing and editing services
- [An editor's role](http://satimaflavell.blogspot.com/2011/10/editors-role.html): Explanation of editorial standards and the editing process for fiction
- [Write a review worth reading](https://satimaflavell.blogspot.com/p/i-love-writing-reviews-reviewing-has.html): Guide to writing compelling book and performance reviews

## Author Reflections & Essays

- [The Artist's Conflict](http://satimaflavell.blogspot.com/2008/01/artists-conflict.html): Essay on narrative decisions and character development in fiction writing
- [The horns of a dilemma](http://satimaflavell.blogspot.com/2008/01/horns-of-dilemma.html): Personal reflection on writer's struggles with Talismans Trilogy structure
- [Writers Week and other delights](http://satimaflavell.blogspot.com/2008/03/writers-week-and-other-delights.html): Commentary on Adelaide Writers Week literary festival and author interviews
